sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The scheme "Petrol Subsidy Scheme" implemented by the Food, Public Distribution & Consumer Affairs Department, Government of Jharkhand, aims to provide a petrol subsidy of ₹250 per month for two-wheelers to eligible NFSA/Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme beneficiaries.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Sector: Financial assistance

**Detailed Description:** The "Petrol Subsidy Scheme" implemented by the Food, Public Distribution & Consumer Affairs Department, Government of Jharkhand, aims to provide financial relief to economically disadvantaged families by offering a petrol subsidy for their two-wheelers. Under this scheme, beneficiaries under the National Food Security Act (NFSA) or Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme receive ₹25/- per liter of petrol for up to 10 liters monthly.

**Benefits / Assistance:** ***Subsidy Amount*** - ₹25/- per liter of petrol for up to 10 liters monthly (₹250/month).  ***Mode of Disbursement:*** - Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the beneficiary's bank account.

**Application Process:** > ***Registration Process:*** - Download the CMSUPPORT app or visit the official portal [jsfss.jharkhand.gov.in](https://jsfss.jharkhand.gov.in/).- Enter your ration card number and Aadhaar number. - An OTP will be sent to the mobile number linked to the Aadhaar. Verify the OTP. > ***Login Credentials:*** - Use your ration card number as the login ID and the last 8 digits of your Aadhaar as the password.  > ***Filling the Form:*** - Select your name from the family members listed on the ration card. - Enter your two-wheeler's registration number and driving license details. > **Verification Process:** - Submitted vehicle details are sent to the DTO (District Transport Office) for verification. - Post verification, the data is forwarded to the District Supply Officer (DSO) for final approval.  > ***Approval and Disbursement:*** - Once approved, the subsidy amount is transferred directly to the applicant's linked bank account through DBT.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Food, Public Distribution and Consumer affairs Department
